Just the Browser is a project that streamlines desktop web browsers by removing unwanted features like AI integrations, telemetry, and sponsored content. It aims to provide a clean, focused browsing experience using hidden enterprise settings and offers easy installation scripts and manual configuration guides for popular browsers.
